content.text: This matches the reference views well. Exporting.

I built the part and exported it to `submission.step`. The export is a single valid solid, and reading the STEP file back gives the same part. All sizes are my estimates from the image, so proportions are approximate.

What I built, a round flange with its axis along X:
- **Body:** a cylinder 100 mm across and 55 mm long, running from x=0 to x=55.
- **+X face:** a 62 mm counterbore, 15 mm deep, with a 34 mm bore running through the whole part.
- **−X face:** 5 small holes, 4 mm across and 12 mm deep, spaced evenly on a 66 mm circle. I made them blind (not through) because the target shows no holes on the counterbore floor.

My preview from the same four camera positions matches the composite in orientation and layout.

Two small details in the target are not in my part:
- a thin ring line near the outer edge of the −X face, which looks like a shallow step or chamfer;
- a single small dot on the +X face just outside the counterbore.

Both are tiny, so leaving them out should barely affect the voxel IoU score.

You can view the part at http://127.0.0.1:8772/#part.FCStd.
